However, Humanoid Robot Pose Estimation (HRPE) lies at the intersection of conventional Robot Pose Estimation (RPE) and Human Pose Estimation (HPE), while not being fully addressed by either paradigm: RPE primarily focuses on non-humanoid robots, particularly fixed-base manipulators, whereas HPE is built upon human-specific skeletal topologies, body models, and motion priors. Despite recent progress in humanoid 2D keypoint detection and HPE adaptation, humanoid-native 3D pose recovery remains insufficiently studied, and a dedicated benchmark with suitable training data and evaluation protocols is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce Humanoids, a benchmark for monocular 3D humanoid robot pose estimation, and propose HumanoidPose, a framework for this task. Humanoids provides synthetic 3D supervision across diverse humanoid embodiments, manually annotated real-world 2D data, and real-world RGB sequences paired with robot states for 3D evaluation on a physical Roban humanoid. HumanoidPose combines human-inspired visual perception with robot articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. Experiments on Humanoids and the DHRP-H1 benchmark demonstrate strong performance in articulation recovery and 3D pose estimation, including zero-shot transfer to real-world 2D and 3D evaluation. Ablation studies further show the contribution of robot-native articulation modeling and explicit kinematic grounding. The dataset and code will be publicly released to support future research in the community.
tldr: 提出Humanoids基准与HumanoidPose框架，实现人形机器人单目3D全身姿态估计。
motivation: 人形机器人单目3D全身姿态估计处于传统机器人位姿估计与人姿态估计的交汇处，但现有RPE主要面向非人形固定基座机械臂，HPE依赖人类特定骨骼拓扑、人体模型与运动先验，均无法充分覆盖该任务。尽管人形2D关键点检测和HPE适配已有进展，人形原生3D位姿恢复仍研究不足，且缺乏专用训练数据、评测协议与基准。
method: 构建Humanoids基准，提供跨多种人形本体的合成3D监督、人工标注真实2D数据，以及在实体Roban人形机器人上采集的RGB序列与机器人状态用于3D评测。提出HumanoidPose框架，将类人视觉感知、机器人关节建模与显式运动学 grounding 相结合。
result: 在Humanoids与DHRP-H1基准上的实验表明，方法在关节恢复和3D位姿估计上表现较强，并支持零样本迁移到真实世界2D与3D评测；消融实验验证了机器人原生关节建模和显式运动学 grounding 的贡献。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作填补了人形机器人单目3D位姿估计在专用基准与原生方法上的空白，并提供可公开的数据集与代码，有望促进外部状态感知、运动分析和机器人学习等后续研究。

title: EgoSurgHands: An Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Dataset & Benchmark for Open Surgery Training
abstract: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. We introduce EgoSurgHands, a benchmark for real-captured egocentric hand pose estimation in open surgery training on synthetic pads. Captured with multi-sensor glasses, it contains 41,909 training hand-instance rows across 55 procedure recordings and 9,476 human-validated evaluation rows across 13 held-out recordings, spanning 13 tasks, 3 glove colors, and 4 trainees from first-year medical student to third-year resident. Each frame carries a multi-sensor stack: intrinsics, hand landmarks with per-hand confidence, timestamps, and eye gaze, plus SLAM extrinsics where SLAM succeeded. Evaluation labels combine sensor-fused pseudo-ground truth, human cross-review of every frame, surgeon adjudication of flagged cases, and an independent multi-view triangulated reference. Alongside the within-corpus, procedure-disjoint split, a leave-one-wearer-out protocol tested unseen trainees. Across eight methods evaluated zero-shot, from MANO-based reconstructors to the two-hand IntagHand and the keypoint-only MediaPipe Hands, egocentric pretraining was associated with stronger transfer on every held-out wearer. WildHands and JointTransformer had 18\% and 40\% lower PA-MPJPE, respectively, than the non-egocentric HaMeR. JointTransformer was the best performing model with an error of 14.95 mm. A substantial surgical domain gap remains, and the widely deployed MediaPipe Hands detected a hand in only 24.1\% of evaluation rows. As a baseline, a 58K-parameter residual corrector (JRN) on frozen backbones reached 10.96-14.85 mm PA-MPJPE on held-out wearers for the two ego-pretrained backbones. We release the dataset and benchmark code at https://egosurghands.github.io
tldr: 提出EgoSurgHands开放手术训练第一视角3D手部姿态数据集与基准，含多传感器标注和留人评估。
motivation: 手术技能评估、AR引导和机器人示范学习均需对术者手部进行3D跟踪，但现有手术数据集缺乏真实采集的第一视角关节化3D手部姿态标注。
method: 用多传感器眼镜采集55段操作、13类任务，提供内参、手部关键点及置信度、时间戳、眼动和SLAM外参；评估标签融合传感器伪真值、逐帧人工复核、外科医生裁定与多视角三角化参考，并设过程不交叉和留一佩戴者协议。
result: 零样本评测8种方法，JointTransformer最佳PA-MPJPE为14.95 mm；WildHands和JointTransformer较非第一视角HaMeR分别低18%和40%，MediaPipe Hands仅24.1%评估帧检出；冻结骨干加58K参数JRN达10.96–14.85 mm。
conclusion: 发布数据集与基准代码，揭示第一视角预训练迁移优势及显著手术域差距，为开放手术训练的手部姿态估计提供可复现评测基础。

title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
abstract: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.
tldr: SGAR用稀疏几何引导注意力替代稠密全局注意力，实现更快更准的大规模前馈三维重建。
motivation: 现有前馈三维重建模型采用稠密全局注意力关联所有视图patch，计算量随视图数二次增长，难以扩展到大规模场景；作者从运动恢复结构角度认为多数稠密注意力计算并非必要。
method: 提出SGAR，用轻量级可学习关键选择模块预测跨视图token的三维邻近性，使每个patch token仅关注其他视图中少量几何相关token，从而以几何相似性引导的稀疏注意力替代稠密全局注意力，并可通过微调应用于不同前馈模型。
result: 实验表明SGAR在稠密与稀疏SOTA方法中速度最快，并在稀疏方法中精度最高；在1000个视图时较稠密注意力最高快12倍，且位姿精度稳定，而现有稀疏方法失效；在相同时间预算下重建出更完整几何。
conclusion: SGAR将经典几何匹配先验引入前馈重建的注意力设计，在保持位姿精度的同时显著提升大规模重建效率与完整性，为可扩展的三维重建提供了通用方案。

title: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
abstract: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.
tldr: FirstCross 用体素网格上的凸优化从稀疏视角单光子数据快速重建三维物体。
motivation: 现有基于神经网络的单光子三维重建（如 Transientangelo）需逐场景非凸优化超过一小时，且光子通量降低时精度显著下降；本文旨在实现少视角、少光子条件下快速且鲁棒的三维重建。
method: FirstCross 是无需网络的体素网格方法，利用泊松似然仅依赖光线首次进入物体的交点这一性质，将似然分解为两项可处理项：一项用运行最大值透射率替代 NeRF 乘积透射率形成紧凸闭包，另一项在物体表面后足够厚假设下为无法解释的光子构造凸上界，并求解短序列凸问题。
result: 在 Transientangelo 的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在所有测试场景、视角数和光子通量下深度误差均更低；三视角且光子数比协议最低通量少 100 倍时，平均物体深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半。经典融合方法误差为本文三视角结果的 1.3–1.8 倍；真实房间尺度 1% 光子数据上，TransientNeRF 误差为本文的 2.8–7.7 倍，且单 GPU 约一分钟完成重建。
conclusion: FirstCross 将少视角单光子扫描曝光量降至 1%，在约一分钟内完成物体重建，表明凸优化可在稀疏视角与极低光子条件下替代非凸神经优化，为快速单光子 3D 重建提供新路线。

title: CryoGaussian: Heterogeneous Cryo-EM Reconstruction Made Explicit with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) determines macromolecular structures from noisy particle images. However, rare, transient compositional states and subtle, continuous conformational variation are difficult to resolve. We present CryoGaussian, a Gaussian splatting method for heterogeneous cryo-EM reconstruction that fits an explicit Gaussian density representation directly to the particle images through a differentiable rasterizer rendering orthographic line integrals modulated by the contrast transfer function. The Gaussians are initialized randomly, with their number derived from the estimated spatial support of the molecular density and their minimum size bounded by the Nyquist frequency of the particle images. To capture the compositional and conformational variation across particle images, we learn particle-image and per-Gaussian latents that jointly modulate the base position, amplitude, and scale of each Gaussian. Each structural state is then reconstructed by fitting the Gaussians conditioned on its inferred latent. On CryoBench, CryoGaussian achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy for both compositional and conformational heterogeneity. On experimental data, it resolves a rare compositional state of the 50S ribosomal subunit (class C4, 1.3% of particles) with rRNA helix 68 docked in the absence of the central protuberance, and continuous conformational motion of the SF3b and helicase subcomplexes of the pre-catalytic spliceosome. We further optimize the rasterizer for additive cryo-EM projection, reducing training time by 12.8-28.0$\times$.
tldr: CryoGaussian 用高斯泼溅显式建模异质冷冻电镜重构，实现高精度与加速。
motivation: 单颗粒冷冻电镜可从噪声粒子图像确定大分子结构，但稀有瞬态组成状态和细微连续构象变异难以解析。
method: 提出 CryoGaussian，以显式高斯密度表示直接拟合粒子图像，通过可微光栅化器渲染受 CTF 调制的正交线积分；高斯随机初始化，数量由密度空间支撑估计确定，最小尺寸受 Nyquist 频率约束；学习粒子图像与逐高斯隐变量联合调制高斯基位置、幅值和尺度，并基于推断隐变量条件重建各结构状态。
result: 在 CryoBench 上，CryoGaussian 在组成异质性和构象异质性两类任务上均取得 state-of-the-art 重构精度；在实验数据中解析了仅占 1.3% 粒子的 50S 核糖体亚基稀有组成状态（class C4，rRNA helix 68 对接且中心突起缺失），并捕捉 pre-catalytic spliceosome 中 SF3b 与 helicase 子复合物的连续构象运动；优化后的加性投影光栅化器将训练时间缩短 12.8–28.0×。
conclusion: CryoGaussian 通过显式高斯泼溅实现异质冷冻电镜重构，可解析稀有组成状态与连续构象变化，并在精度和训练效率上表现优异，为冷冻电镜异质性分析提供了可解释且高效的新路线。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
abstract: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.
tldr: 提出域感知共形预测，用真实外观迁移校准，恢复航天器位姿估计覆盖并大幅减少静默失败。
motivation: 自主交会与近距离操作不仅需要准确估计目标航天器位姿，还需要可靠判断估计何时可信。共形预测可提供带形式保证的位姿不确定集，但其同分布假设在仅有合成标定图像、测试为真实在轨图像时被违反，导致真实图像上覆盖保证失效并出现静默失败。
method: 在SPEED+数据集上验证合成图像校准的共形位姿估计在真实图像上失去覆盖保证后，提出将合成图像迁移到真实图像外观再进行校准。由于外观迁移保持几何不变，合成位姿标签仍然有效，且无需任何带标签的真实图像；实验采用两种图像迁移模型。
result: 实验表明，该域感知校准在误覆盖水平0.1及以上恢复了达到指定水平的覆盖，并将静默失败从最多43.5%的测试图像降至最多3.3%。
conclusion: 该方法无需真实标签即可缓解仿真到现实的分布偏移，使共形位姿估计更接近航天器在轨可信部署。其贡献在于揭示并量化了合成校准在真实图像上的静默失败，并给出保持几何标签有效的域感知校准方案。

title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
abstract: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.
tldr: PaveSplat 在解析表面对齐协方差上学习残差四元数，使前馈高斯泼溅在高分辨率重渲染时不再出现孔洞。
motivation: 像素对齐的前馈高斯泼溅对每个像素只预测一个图元，其渲染质量取决于这些图元对表面的覆盖程度。现有基于 surfel 的方法从预测深度解析计算表面对齐协方差，但当深度导出的坐标系病态时，该协方差无法修正 surfel 朝向，导致 surfel 只是松散地覆盖表面；在训练分辨率下，每个 surfel 的最小一像素足迹可以掩盖这些缝隙，但用同一预测结果在更高分辨率重渲染时，缝隙就会变成孔洞。
method: PaveSplat 保留解析协方差作为初始化，让其轴与表面切向对齐，并在其上叠加一个以单位四元数初始化的残差，仅当能改善渲染时才重新定向 surfel，从而把被解析坐标系错误指向的 surfel 重新贴合回表面；整个流程为单次前馈，无需针对显示分辨率重新运行网络。
result: 在 RealEstate10K 上，PaveSplat 在 1x–8x 所有尺度下均取得单像素单高斯方法中最佳的 PSNR、SSIM 与 LPIPS；原生分辨率下增益较小，优势主要体现在用同一预测结果提升显示分辨率重渲染时。在零样本 DL3DV 上，该方法在该组方法中所有尺度下 PSNR 领先，SSIM/LPIPS 排名第一或第二；覆盖孔洞分析显示，在高分辨率重渲染下其未覆盖像素数少于两个基线方法。
conclusion: 通过残差四元数修正病态深度坐标系下的 surfel 朝向，PaveSplat 以极小的原生分辨率代价换取了跨渲染分辨率的鲁棒覆盖质量，为前馈高斯泼溅在可变显示分辨率下的实用化提供了简洁有效的方案。

title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
abstract: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.
tldr: 提出三阶段GS-VTON-MVT框架，通过多视角Transformer与几何引导ControlNet实现一致的3DGS虚拟试穿。
motivation: 现有3D虚拟试穿流程基本独立编辑各训练视角，并依赖人工选择参考视角和固定注意力融合权重等启发式方法，导致跨视角不一致被固化进3D表示，在新视角中出现纹理漂移、印花模糊和几何不合理等问题。
method: GS-VTON-MVT采用三阶段框架：多视角修复Transformer以完整跨视角自注意力联合编辑训练视角，学习而非强制跨视角对应关系；几何引导多模态ControlNet将服装图像与当前3DGS状态渲染的深度和表面法线共同作为条件，为视觉证据薄弱区域提供显式结构；姿态自适应人物感知注意力用相机位姿邻近度替代当前视角与参考视角特征间的固定融合权重。
result: 在3D-VTONBench基准上，GS-VTON-MVT在FID、KID、基于LPIPS的跨视角一致性和用户偏好方面优于通用3D编辑器和已有3D试穿方法；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作结合隐式与显式3D推理，使跨视角对应关系可学习，并从条件控制和特征融合层面提升3DGS虚拟试穿的一致性，有望减少新视角纹理漂移与几何伪影。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
abstract:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution.
  Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models.
  Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.
tldr: AGSR通过推理时收缩高斯投影协方差并融合多孔径渲染，实现轻量实时的3DGS超分辨率增强。
motivation: 3DGS 可实现实时新视角合成，但高斯光栅化会因每个基元的投影协方差而衰减细尺度结构；有限高斯足迹造成有效带宽受限。
method: 提出 AGSR，一种推理时轻量框架：在推理时收缩投影协方差以生成多孔径渲染，并利用不确定性引导的特征聚合以及透射率和深度线索的几何条件进行渐进融合；可作为预训练 3DGS 模型的即插即用增强模块。
result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360 基准上，AGSR 优于轻量级图像空间超分辨率基线，且当底层高斯表示退化时增益增大；模型仅需最多 139k 参数并保持实时性能。
conclusion: 结果表明协方差收缩能够显露被原生高斯光栅化衰减的带宽敏感结构线索；AGSR 以轻量即插即用方式提升预训练 3DGS 的超分辨率表现，具有实际增强潜力。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
abstract: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.
tldr: 提出全稀疏多视图RGB-D位姿估计器SCCV-6D，在杂乱工业料箱场景中兼顾精度与速度。
motivation: 工业料箱抓取需要在杂乱、部分遮挡以及反光、无纹理零件条件下获得准确6D位姿，而多阶段方法虽精度高但内存和运行时间难以满足实际部署约束，整体式方法又常依赖盲目子采样或降低分辨率控制成本。
method: SCCV-6D构建毫米级精度的全稀疏多视图RGB-D表示，通过分阶段热图机制裁剪背景，并在最高分辨率下同时预测任意数量物体的类别、平移偏移和旋转；旋转采用带置信度的规范坐标投票，结合对称性感知加权Procrustes求解实现闭式位姿恢复，并利用偏移投票完成簇内点恢复以去除耗时后处理，同时复用热图任务监督注意力先验设计注意力门控蒸馏目标。
result: 在IPD测试集上取得0.826 AP，每场景耗时1.13 s，显著快于领先方法；在MV-YCB上达到96.1 ADD-S，并在密集堆叠的ROBI料箱上保持竞争力。
conclusion: 该工作以单次全稀疏多视图RGB-D流程实现有竞争力的6D位姿精度和较快运行速度，减少后处理阶段，对工业料箱抓取部署具有潜在价值。

title: Multi-View Relighting with Mergeable Radiance Fields
abstract: We propose MergeableRF, a method for radiance field relighting through model parameter merging. Given multi-view images of a scene under known basis lights, our goal is to relight the scene by directly combining the parameters of radiance fields trained under these lights. This is motivated by the linearity of light transport: the image under a mixture of lights is the same weighted combination of the images under each light. However, combining the parameters of independently trained radiance fields does not produce the corresponding combination of images. To address this, we represent a scene with shared geometry and a separate appearance network for each basis light. We start these networks from the same initialization and introduce merge-aware training, which teaches their parameter combinations to reproduce the corresponding combinations of images. Given a target HDR environment map, we compute its basis-light coefficients and use them to merge the appearance networks into a single relit model. Our method supports both Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), without material estimation, additional relighting networks, or target-specific optimization. Unlike image-space blending, it requires only one rendering pass per viewpoint. Experiments on synthetic Neural Gaffer objects and real OLATverse captures demonstrate relighting quality competitive with methods trained on the same multi-light observations.
tldr: 提出MergeableRF，通过合并各基光外观网络参数实现无需目标优化的多视图重光照。
motivation: 利用光传输线性，混合光照图像应为各基光图像的加权组合；但独立训练的辐射场参数直接合并并不能产生对应的图像组合，因此需要让辐射场参数具备可合并性。
method: 采用共享几何与每个基光独立外观网络的表示，从相同初始化出发，并用merge-aware training约束外观网络参数组合复现对应图像组合；给定目标HDR环境图后计算基光系数，将外观网络合并为单一重光照模型，支持NeRF和3DGS，无需材质估计、额外重光照网络或目标特定优化。
result: 在合成Neural Gaffer物体和真实OLATverse捕获上实验，重光照质量与使用相同多光照观测训练的方法相当；摘要未提供具体量化指标，且相较图像空间混合每视角仅需一次渲染。
conclusion: 提出了一种通过合并辐射场参数实现多视图重光照的框架，避免目标特定优化和图像空间混合，兼容NeRF与3DGS，为高效多光照场景重光照提供了新思路。

title: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSEPose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerancedilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.
tldr: 提出MORSEPose，用位姿与尺寸包络替代表面距离选择重建点，实现无网格类别级6D位姿估计。
motivation: 类别级6D位姿估计需将未见实例的部分RGB-D观测关联到类别规范帧，现有方法常依赖配准后的实例表面按距离选择重建点，限制了对标准标注的直接利用。本文旨在不依赖网格或表面距离选择器的情况下，从位姿与度量尺寸标注中直接构造重建监督。
method: MORSEPose将观测3D点映射到归一化物体坐标，并保留落在由位姿和度量尺寸构造的容差膨胀包络内的点，形成跨相机帧与度量尺度一致的支撑集；当标注范围包住物体表面时，该包络可保守包含传统表面距离选择器的支撑集。方法将该目标与多级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点和可学习类别上下文集成。
result: 在REAL275和HouseCat6D上，包络监督在点级和任务级均与基于表面的监督接近，在边界扰动和视角变化下保持稳定，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的类别级位姿精度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 研究表明可利用标准位姿与尺寸标注构造无网格、跨帧一致的重建监督，避免对配准实例表面的依赖，为类别级6D位姿估计提供了更简洁且稳健的监督方式，并具备在真实RGB-D场景中推广的潜力。

title: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
abstract: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.
tldr: 提出闭环耦合几何前馈稠密深度模型与因子图优化的立体视觉里程计，实现稠密度量建图。
motivation: 传统模型法SVO稳健高效，但难以直接获得稠密度量深度；学习型稠密深度预测易受噪声和尺度不一致影响。需要利用稀疏但可靠的立体与多视图度量几何校准稠密预测，同时保持SVO的鲁棒性与效率。
method: 利用优化后的3D路标在每个局部子图内联合估计所有关键帧的尺度-平移变换，以校准GFM稠密深度预测；构建分层因子图，局部滑窗估计高频位姿与多视图精化路标，关键帧稠密预测经SE(3) Generalized ICP配准，连续子图用共享几何做Sim(3)对齐，并将子图内与子图间约束纳入全局因子图。
result: 在公开和自建数据集上，该方法相对几何与学习型基线取得有竞争力的里程计精度，并能输出准确的稠密度量重建；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但报告了对学习深度预测失败更强的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该工作表明，将可靠稀疏度量几何作为闭环约束校准前馈稠密模型，可在保持模型法SVO效率与鲁棒性的同时获得一致轨迹和稠密度量地图，对SLAM与稠密建图具有潜在价值。

title: VideoRNG: Relightable Neural Gaussians from Generative Video Models
abstract: Generating realistic 3D assets remains constrained by classical representations: surface meshes and compact physically based materials struggle to express objects whose appearance arises from fine geometry or complex light transport, while existing Gaussian-splatting generators typically bake fixed illumination into appearance. We introduce VideoRNG, a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or a single image without prescribing a mesh or analytic material model. A video generator fine-tuned from a pretrained video diffusion backbone first produces a structured RGBA turntable sequence under a known pose, camera, and illumination. A feed-forward large reconstruction model initialized from a pretrained video diffusion backbone then maps the video-VAE latent frames of selected turntable frames directly to millions of anisotropic Gaussians with learned neural appearance features. A shared directional decoder and stochastic Gaussian ray tracer turn this representation, which we call ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians (rtRNG), into radiance under novel viewpoints and illumination. To preserve high-frequency appearance while learning geometry, we introduce depth-anchored appearance training, and we make million-Gaussian reconstruction practical through foreground token selection and cost-aware distributed sampling. VideoRNG generates complex assets such as fur, feathers, and spider webs that can be interactively rendered, relit, and integrated into scenes.
tldr: VideoRNG 用两阶段视频扩散与高斯重建从文本或单图生成可重光照的 3D 资产。
motivation: 现有表面网格与紧凑 PBR 材质难以表达由精细几何或复杂光传输决定外观的物体，而现有 Gaussian-splatting 生成器通常将固定光照烘焙进外观，导致无法重光照。本文旨在无需预设网格或解析材质模型，从文本或单张图像生成完整可重光照 3D 资产。
method: VideoRNG 采用两阶段路线：先微调预训练视频扩散骨干，在已知姿态、相机与光照下生成结构化 RGBA 转台序列；再以预训练视频扩散骨干初始化的前馈大重建模型，将选定帧的 video-VAE 隐特征直接映射为数百万各向异性高斯及学习到的神经外观特征。共享方向解码器与随机高斯光线追踪器将 rtRNG 表示转化为新视角和新光照下的辐射度，并通过深度锚定外观训练、前景 token 选择与代价感知分布式采样兼顾高频外观与百万级高斯重建效率。
result: 摘要未提供量化指标；实验展示该方法可生成毛皮、羽毛和蜘蛛网等传统表示难以表达的复杂资产，并支持交互式渲染、重光照及场景集成。
conclusion: VideoRNG 证明了可从生成视频模型构建完整、可重光照的神经高斯 3D 资产，无需网格或解析材质模型，为复杂外观资产的生成、编辑与场景级集成提供了新路线。

title: Multi-Band Galaxy Novel-View Synthesis with Radiative Gaussian Fields
abstract: We propose a novel view synthesis tool for galaxies based on Gaussian Splatting (GS). Unlike RGB data, where GS has achieved success, galaxy observations consist of multi-band signals from a massive number of bodies, contain complex patterns of cross-band interactions, and capture light propagation in highly heterogeneous media. As a result, the underlying physical process poses great challenges in model representation and optimization, which have not been investigated in existing research. To this end, we propose a physically inspired Gaussian Splatting method, GalaxyGS, which is equipped with physically meaningful components that capture both the energy emission mechanism of different astronomical bodies and the light propagation between them. In the absence of directly comparable baseline methods, we adopt a wide range of possible alternative approaches. Comparisons conclusively demonstrate that GalaxyGS is better in accuracy and physical fidelity across datasets and metrics.
tldr: 提出 GalaxyGS，用物理启发的 Gaussian Splatting 实现多波段星系新视角合成。
motivation: RGB 数据的 Gaussian Splatting 已成功，但星系观测由大量天体的多波段信号组成，存在复杂的跨波段相互作用，并涉及高度非均匀介质中的光传播，现有方法难以建模和优化。
method: 提出物理启发的 Gaussian Splatting 方法 GalaxyGS，引入具有物理意义的组件，分别刻画不同天文天体的能量发射机制及天体间的光传播过程。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；对比实验表明 GalaxyGS 在多个数据集和指标上均优于多种替代方法，具有更高的准确性和物理保真度。
conclusion: 该工作为多波段星系观测提供新的新视角合成工具，在缺乏直接可比基线的情况下仍展示出准确性与物理一致性优势，有望服务于天文可视化与物理一致的重建分析。

title: RAPID: Reconstruction Accelerated by Polarization-Informed Depth for 2D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.
tldr: RAPID利用多视角偏振线索构建稠密深度先验，加速2D高斯泼溅表面重建。
motivation: 现有高斯泼溅重建方法多依赖稀疏几何初始化与迭代致密化，导致优化开销大，且难以在反射和弱纹理区域兼顾渲染质量与几何精度。
method: 提出几何优先框架RAPID，利用多视角偏振线索恢复稠密表面先验；借助稀疏几何锚点将表面法线融入深度图并进行跨视角融合，再通过曲率自适应采样与有向高斯初始化支持高效优化。
result: 在PISR数据集上相较SOTA方法PhyGaP约实现5倍加速，平均优化时间从约21分钟降至4分钟，同时保持有竞争力的新视角合成质量与网格重建精度。
conclusion: 结果表明RAPID能有效利用偏振多视角输入加速高斯优化，为高效且几何准确的三维表面重建提供了新思路。

title: Object Pose: The Link between Weak Perspective, Paraperspective, and Full Perspective
abstract: Recently, DeMenthon and Davis [4,5] proposed a method for determining the pose of a 3-D object with respect to a camera from 3-D to 2-D point correspondences. The method consists of iteratively improving the pose computed with a weak perspective camera model to converge, at the limit, to a pose estimation computed with a perspective camera model. In this paper we give an algebraic derivation of DeMenthon and Davis' method and we show that it belongs to a larger class of methods where the perspective camera model is approximated either at zero order (weak perspective) or first order (paraperspective). We describe in detail an iterative paraperspective pose computation method for both non coplanar and coplanar object points. We analyse the convergence of these methods and we conclude that the iterative paraperspective method (proposed in this paper) has better convergence properties than the iterative weak perspective method. We introduce a simple way of taking into account the orthogonality constraint associated with the rotation matrix. We analyse the sensitivity to camera calibration errors and we define the optimal experimental setup with respect to imprecise camera calibration. We compare the results obtained with this method and with a non-linear optimization method.
tldr: 该文统一推导弱透视与准透视姿态估计，并提出收敛性更优的迭代准透视方法。
motivation: 研究如何由3-D到2-D点对应确定物体相对相机的位姿，并深入理解DeMenthon和Davis提出的迭代弱透视方法及其与完整透视模型之间的关系。
method: 对DeMenthon-Davis方法给出代数推导，将其纳入零阶弱透视和一阶paraperspective近似透视相机的统一框架；详细给出适用于非共面与共面物点的迭代paraperspective位姿计算方法，分析收敛性、旋转矩阵正交约束的处理方式以及相机标定误差敏感性。
result: 摘要指出迭代paraperspective方法比迭代弱透视方法具有更好的收敛性质，并给出针对不精确相机标定的最优实验配置分析，同时将该方法与非线性优化方法进行比较；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 论文建立了弱透视、paraperspective与完整透视姿态估计之间的理论联系，提出的迭代paraperspective方法在收敛性上更优，并为相机标定误差下的实验设计提供指导，对基于点对应的物体位姿估计具有方法学贡献。

title: Facet-SLAM: Real-Time Triangle Splatting SLAM
abstract: Dense SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian splatting build maps that render photorealistically, but their surface geometry is poor, and obtaining a mesh requires extraction or fusion stages. Triangle splatting avoids this with surface primitives whose vertices can be triangulated directly into a connected mesh, yet SLAM with this representation has so far relied on photometric tracking, which is too slow for localization at sensor rate. We present Facet-SLAM, the first real-time triangle splatting SLAM system for RGB-D cameras. Fast geometric registration is the natural alternative, but it is not sufficient alone, since the mapper's optimization displaces triangles from the observed surface and makes them unreliable registration targets. We therefore separate the two roles: the tracker sets each triangle's centroid from fused depth and registers frames to these centroids by GICP, while the mapper is restricted to non-translating updates via a change of variables. Our system achieves competitive tracking accuracy at around 100 FPS on a desktop GPU and runs at sensor rate on a Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with the photometric approach, it is over 20 times faster, matches rendering quality, and improves surface accuracy, reducing the chamfer distance of the Delaunay mesh on Replica from 1.55 to 0.86 cm. We will release the implementation at https://github.com/edward62740/Facet-SLAM.
tldr: Facet-SLAM 提出首个面向 RGB-D 相机的实时三角面片 splatting SLAM，通过 GICP 跟踪与受限非平移建图实现高精度表面重建。
motivation: 基于 3D Gaussian splatting 的稠密 SLAM 虽能逼真渲染，但表面几何较差且需额外提取或融合才能得到网格；三角面片 splatting 可直接三角化为连通网格，但现有该类 SLAM 依赖光度跟踪，速度不足以在传感器帧率下定位。
method: Facet-SLAM 将跟踪与建图角色分离：跟踪器利用融合深度设置每个三角面片的质心，并用 GICP 将帧配准到这些质心；建图器通过变量替换限制为非平移更新，避免优化使三角面片偏离观测表面而影响配准。
result: 系统在桌面 GPU 上以约 100 FPS 实现有竞争力的跟踪精度，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 上达到传感器帧率；相比光度方法速度提升超过 20 倍，渲染质量相当，并将 Replica 上 Delaunay 网格的 chamfer 距离从 1.55 cm 降至 0.86 cm。
conclusion: Facet-SLAM 是首个实时三角面片 splatting RGB-D SLAM 系统，在保持渲染质量的同时显著提升表面精度与运行速度，为直接网格化稠密 SLAM 提供了实用方案，并计划开源实现。

title: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/
tldr: 提出分层机载视觉语言导航框架VLN-AR，结合3DGS数据生成与轻量化优化，实现复杂环境下无人机长程导航。
motivation: 现有基础模型驱动的无人机导航方法受限于3D数据稀缺、轨迹可行性不足、长程推理能力弱以及机载计算效率低，难以在严格资源约束下完成复杂环境中的语义推理与长程导航。
method: VLN-AR将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，结构化预测3D位姿指令和导航意图并转化为动态可行动作；构建全自动3D Gaussian Splatting流水线生成可扩展的逼真无人机导航数据，采用渐进式三阶段训练增强grounding、场景推理与复杂导航能力，并引入记忆感知任务分解的轻量认知智能体提升长程推理。机载端进一步采用token稀疏化与模型轻量化优化。
result: 实验表明该方法在仿真和真实无人机导航中均较现有方法取得显著提升，同时通过token稀疏化和模型轻量化实现7.1倍至9.4倍加速，并在资源受限的无人机平台上保持较高导航性能。
conclusion: 该工作提出面向复杂环境的层次化机载视觉语言导航框架，通过3DGS数据生成、渐进训练、长程认知分解与机载优化缓解数据、推理和计算瓶颈，为资源受限无人机实现语义推理与长程导航提供了可行方案。

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
tldr: 提出几何桥流匹配先验，用于头锥束CT盲刚性运动校正，兼顾图像重建与姿态估计。
motivation: 头锥束CT扫描期间患者头部的刚性运动会导致图像质量下降，并增加从投影中恢复准确解剖结构的难度。该研究旨在实现无需额外运动测量的盲刚性运动校正。
method: 方法构建3D流匹配先验来学习运动引起的图像变化，其几何桥通过逐步减少模拟运动，将同一源体积的运动损坏与无运动FDK重建图像连接起来，并利用前向投影器的几何导数提供解析速度目标。整体采用即插即用迭代框架，结合学习到的图像更新、样条姿态估计、共轭梯度数据一致性和图像全变分正则化。
result: 在30名留出CQ500患者的模拟360视角扫描上（每分量运动幅度不超过10 mm/10度），方法取得优于learned autofocus和diffusion-based joint reconstruction的重建质量与运动精度，平均PSNR达37.1 dB，探测器平面重投影误差为0.27 mm。在推理设置端点匹配时，几何桥相较image-linear training将PSNR提升1.6 dB、RPE降低33%；50次先验更新和由粗到细运动估计在RTX A6000上平均每患者耗时9.1分钟。
conclusion: 该框架同时获得高质量图像重建和准确运动估计，验证了几何桥流匹配先验在头锥束CT盲刚性运动校正中的有效性，并展示了临床CBCT运动伪影校正的应用潜力。

title: What Do Learned 3D Models Add to Localization from Posed References?
abstract: Localizing a query from a few posed reference images avoids building a 3D point map. We ask what the camera predictions of learned 3D models add to geometric estimation from the same references, and where failures arise. Across eight learned models and variants and five test sets, we compare reference budgets, swap pose components, and intervene on the references a model sees. At fine pose-error thresholds, geometric estimation with one additional reference is significantly more accurate than every model on two references on Cambridge and NAVER B1 and never significantly worse, alone or as a fallback behind a shared acceptance gate; with the same three references, the more accurate approach depends on the scene. The gain from the learned translation magnitude depends on reference selection: it improves seven of the eight models on 12-Scenes with the spread-out pairs we select, but none of the five we test with the two top-ranked retrieved references. Where retrieval also returns references from other locations, at NAVER Gangnam Station, models fail at different stages. A robust alignment brings Pi3X and MapAnything within 3.3 pp of adding references as needed. In controlled tests, aligning on the nearby references largely restores VGGT, Pi3X and MapAnything but not Depth Anything 3, and pose-conditioned Pi3X recovers only if the far poses are masked and left out of its input-pose normalization.
tldr: 系统比较学习式3D模型与几何估计在少参考图像定位中的表现，揭示收益条件、失败阶段及鲁棒对齐的作用。
motivation: 少位姿参考图像定位可避免构建三维点云地图，但学习式3D模型的相机位姿预测相对传统几何估计究竟带来何种增益、在哪些条件下失效尚不明确。本文旨在系统回答该问题并定位失败来源。
method: 在8个学习式3D模型及其变体、5个测试集上，比较不同参考图像预算、交换位姿分量并干预模型可见参考图像；同时分析检索返回异地点参考时的失败阶段，并评估鲁棒对齐策略。
result: 在细粒度位姿误差阈值下，几何估计增加一张参考图像后在Cambridge和NAVER B1上显著优于所有使用两张参考的模型，且无论单独使用还是作为共享接受门后的回退均不显著更差；使用相同三张参考时，更优方法依场景而定。学习式平移幅度的增益依赖参考选择：在12-Scenes上使用所选分散图像对时，8个模型中有7个提升，但使用检索排名最高的两张参考时5个模型均无提升。NAVER Gangnam Station中模型在不同阶段失败；鲁棒对齐使Pi3X和MapAnything与按需增加参考的差距缩小至3.3个百分点内，近邻参考对齐可大部分恢复VGGT、Pi3X和MapAnything但无法恢复Depth Anything 3，pose-conditioned Pi3X仅在遮蔽远位姿并将其排除出输入位姿归一化时恢复。
conclusion: 研究表明学习式3D模型并非普遍优于几何估计，其收益受参考选择、场景和失败阶段影响；参考管理、共享接受门与鲁棒对齐对少参考定位至关重要。

title: LightSEAD: Lightweight SE(3)-Aware Keypoint Detector through Selective Knowledge Distillation
abstract: The pursuit of improved performance in deep learning has often been accompanied by increasing architectural complexity and computational demands. We explore an alternative direction: achieving more with less through structured supervision. We introduce LightSEAD, a lightweight SE(3)-aware keypoint detector initialised with calibrated Harris pseudo-labels and enriched through viewpoint-aware and appearance-aware supervision and selective knowledge distillation. LightSEAD comprises only six convolutional layers and 84,289 learnable parameters, achieving competitive repeatability across HPatches, KITTI 06 and 4Seasons while demonstrating its downstream applicability to relative pose estimation on MegaDepth-1500. Further optimised for mixed-precision inference, LightSEAD Coarse achieves approximately 909 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 and 139 FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano Super.
tldr: LightSEAD通过选择性知识蒸馏与多视角/外观监督，以6层卷积实现轻量SE(3)关键点检测。
motivation: 针对深度学习模型日益复杂、计算需求高的问题，论文探索以结构化监督实现“以更少资源获得更多性能”。其目标是构建轻量且具备SE(3)感知能力的关键点检测器。
method: LightSEAD仅含6个卷积层和84,289个可学习参数，先用校准的Harris伪标签初始化，再结合视角感知与外观感知监督以及选择性知识蒸馏进行增强。
result: 在HPatches、KITTI 06和4Seasons上取得有竞争力的重复性，并在MegaDepth-1500上验证相对位姿估计的下游适用性；混合精度推理下，LightSEAD Coarse在RTX 4090上约909 FPS、Jetson Orin Nano Super上139 FPS。
conclusion: 表明通过结构化监督和选择性知识蒸馏，极轻量关键点检测器可在保持竞争性能的同时实现高推理效率，适合资源受限平台。

title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
abstract: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU. A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps. Recent work has explored several approaches to this problem. What is essential is the multi-view agreement (Accord), which is considered in SLAM as a source of geometric self-consistency. Accord anchors each keyframe window to metric 3D points triangulated from the filter poses, then exploits bidirectional dense depth agreement between co-visible images to estimate and correct per-image scale errors while preserving the metric scale established by the anchors. Context keyframes further improve depth prediction, and the resulting submaps are fused in a factor graph. We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset. With nothing tuned per dataset/setup and every map aligned only by Accord's own trajectory, Accord achieves consistently best/second-best mean F-score at 5 cm on every platform. Accord is open-source along with the phone-rig dataset for the benefit of the research community
tldr: Accord 利用VIO姿态锚定与多视图深度一致性，实现单目相机加IMU的在线稠密度量建图。
motivation: 单目相机与IMU的稠密度量建图仍具挑战：VIO能提供度量运动但几何稀疏，前馈深度模型能预测稠密结构却缺乏度量尺度。Accord旨在无需针对特定相机或数据集调参，从任意相机加IMU构建准确的在线稠密度量地图。
method: Accord先用VIO滤波器输出度量位姿，并以这些位姿为条件让深度基础模型在短关键帧窗口内预测深度；随后将每个关键帧窗口锚定到由滤波器位姿三角化得到的度量3D点，利用共视图像间的双向稠密深度一致性估计并校正逐图像尺度误差，同时保持锚点建立的度量尺度；上下文关键帧进一步提升深度预测，最终在因子图中融合子图。
result: 论文在五个公开相机-IMU配置以及新的Phone-rig/GoPro数据集上评估同一套建图配置，未针对各数据集或配置调参，且所有地图仅用Accord自身轨迹对齐；Accord在每个平台上均取得5 cm处平均F-score的最佳或次佳结果。
conclusion: Accord将多视图一致性作为SLAM中的几何自洽来源，实现了从单目相机与IMU进行在线稠密度量建图，并开源代码及Phone-rig数据集以促进研究。该方法有望提升跨设备、跨场景的稠密度量建图泛化性与实用性。

title: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. Across a variety of controlled synthetic and real-world tasks, Infer3D demonstrates superior OOD reconstruction accuracy compared to feedforward networks trained on equal or larger datasets. Furthermore, mirroring how human perception requires more time to process confusing stimuli, we introduce an adaptive inference strategy that expends more test-time compute on ambiguous OOD examples while efficiently routing in-distribution inputs. Project website: https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/
tldr: Infer3D通过逆生成建模恢复潜变量，实现鲁棒的OOD单目3D重建。
motivation: 当前主流3D重建神经网络依赖摊销式前馈推理，速度快但在训练分布外场景中性能显著退化。受人类视觉自顶向下生成式推断启发，研究旨在提升单目3D重建的分布外泛化能力。
method: 提出Infer3D逆生成建模框架，通过恢复生成模型潜变量来最佳匹配单目输入。将生成式图像先验与冻结的3D提升网络耦合，把优化空间约束到有效且多视角一致的3D流形上。引入自适应推理策略，对模糊OOD样本分配更多测试时计算，并高效路由分布内输入。
result: 在多种受控合成与真实世界任务中，Infer3D的OOD重建精度优于在同等或更大数据集上训练的前馈网络。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但强调了自适应推理在模糊OOD样本上增加测试时计算、对分布内输入高效路由的特性。
conclusion: 结果表明逆生成建模能显著增强3D重建的分布外鲁棒性，并提供测试时自适应计算的新思路。该工作贡献了更接近人类视觉推断机制的3D理解框架，对鲁棒单目3D重建具有潜在影响。

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
tldr: 提出几何桥流匹配先验，用于头锥束CT盲刚性运动校正。
motivation: 头锥束CT扫描中患者头部刚性运动会导致图像质量下降，并增加从投影中恢复准确解剖结构的难度；该研究旨在无额外运动测量的条件下实现盲刚性运动校正。
method: 方法构建3D流匹配先验学习运动引起的图像变化，其几何桥通过逐步减少模拟运动连接同一源体积的运动损坏与无运动FDK重建图像，并利用前向投影器的几何导数提供解析速度目标。推理采用即插即用循环，结合学习图像更新、样条位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性和图像全变分正则，同时评估精炼图像体及估计位姿下的FDK重建体。
result: 在30例留出CQ500患者的模拟360视角扫描上（各分量运动幅度不超过10 mm/10度），方法取得优于学习自动聚焦和扩散联合重建等方法的图像质量与运动精度，平均PSNR达37.1 dB，平均探测器平面重投影误差为0.27 mm。匹配推理端点设置下，几何桥相较图像线性训练将PSNR提高1.6 dB并将RPE降低33%；采用50次先验更新和由粗到细运动估计时，RTX A6000上平均每患者处理时间为9.1分钟。
conclusion: 几何桥流匹配可有效实现盲刚性运动校正，在获得高质量重建的同时准确估计位姿，并具有即插即用集成潜力。该框架有望提升头锥束CT在运动场景下的临床可用性与解剖结构恢复可靠性。

title: ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. A shared blend-aware color refinement network with only 44.7K parameters refines an analytic color update to realize either color mapping without rendering. It preserves geometry and delivers standard 3DGS assets in seconds. We also design the ReTouch3D benchmark to support the evaluation of aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer across viewpoints. Experiments demonstrate high color accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenes in both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.
tldr: ReTouchGS 是首个免参考、免渲染的 3DGS 美学色彩增强框架，利用场景级 LUT 实现跨视角一致调色。
motivation: 现有 3DGS 色彩迁移与编辑依赖参考图像或用户指定调色参数，且需保持跨视角颜色与色调一致；本文旨在为预训练 3DGS 提供自动、美学导向的免参考色彩增强。
method: ReTouchGS 从预训练 3DGS 模型及相机参数预测场景级 LUT；在参考引导迁移中，利用同一场景的一张编辑视图与对应原始渲染拟合场景级 LUT，并通过仅 44.7K 参数的共享 blend-aware 颜色细化网络修正解析颜色更新，实现无需渲染的颜色映射。
result: 作者构建 ReTouch3D 基准，实验显示该方法在美学色彩增强和参考引导色彩迁移中均具有高颜色精度，并对未见场景表现出强泛化能力；可在数秒内输出保持几何的标准 3DGS 资产。
conclusion: ReTouchGS 是首个面向预训练 3DGS 的免参考美学色彩增强框架，贡献了场景级 LUT 预测、轻量免渲染细化网络与 ReTouch3D 基准，为高效跨视角一致调色提供了新方案。

title: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.
tldr: Refin3R利用SfM点引导双分支网络双向交互，细化前馈点图，提升多视图重建精度与速度。
motivation: 前馈三维重建模型单次预测密集点图，但缺乏显式几何约束，预测常跨视图不一致且细节精度不足。现有引入相机位姿或深度先验的方法多仅作辅助输入、逐视图独立处理，或只在先验覆盖区域细化几何。
method: Refin3R以SfM点作为几何引导，将SfM几何传播到图像网格。其双分支架构中，2D分支借助几何感知主干特征扩展SfM覆盖范围，3D分支对所有视图的SfM点进行推理以捕获图像网格难以表示的多视图结构，两分支双向交换信息联合细化每个视图，输出稠密准确点图。
result: 在ScanNet++、ETH3D、Tanks&Temples以及域外人体和手术场景中，Refin3R在点图精度上持续优于前馈和几何引导方法，且运行速度快于最强的几何引导基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，将SfM几何显式传播并与双分支多视图推理结合，可有效提升前馈重建的跨视图一致性和细节精度。其贡献在于提出统一的几何引导细化框架，并展示跨域泛化潜力和效率优势。

title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
abstract: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)
tldr: PeriaTrace实现根尖片逐牙诊断、视觉可溯源报告及患者友好解释。
motivation: 根尖片是牙髓诊断核心，但人工判读与报告撰写耗时，专业术语影响患者理解；现有自动化方法常缺乏影像证据与发现之间的牙级关联。
method: 提出三阶段框架PeriaTrace，依次完成牙级诊断、视觉定位的报告生成，以及通俗解释与护理建议；基于12,877张根尖片内部数据及两个外部临床队列开发与评估。
result: 内部评估宏Dice 85.35%、BLEU-4 0.6504，牙定位与FDI识别联合F1 94.37%，视觉定位标签F1 77.93%。两个外部队列中资深牙髓医生认为91.16%和84.52%的报告可直接保留或修改而无需重写，平均每张4.41秒。196名无医学背景受访者中96.4%偏好含通俗解释与护理建议的报告，84.7%认为视觉定位提示有帮助。
conclusion: PeriaTrace可加速报告生成并保留证据溯源，支持临床复核与患者沟通，有望改善牙髓诊疗流程。

title: You Only Encode Once: Sub-Pixel-Shifted Frames for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of remote sensing images remains challenging due to the limited high-frequency information in a single low-resolution (LR) observation. While multi-frame SR can exploit complementary sub-pixel information, existing approaches often require real multi-frame training sequences and repeated feature encoding, increasing data acquisition demands and computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose SPS-GS (Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splatting), an encode-once framework that learns from multi-phase LR observations synthesized from individual high-resolution images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) exploits shift-dependent aliasing through Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation, enabling multi-frame information to be integrated before a single deep encoding pass. Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian centers and colors using multi-observation back-projection to promote observation consistency. The refined Gaussians support continuous rendering at arbitrary scales. Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales. The code will be publicly released.
tldr: 提出SPS-GS单次编码框架，用子像素移相混叠解调与2D高斯泼溅实现任意尺度遥感超分。
motivation: 遥感图像任意尺度超分（ASSR）受限于单张低分辨率观测中高频信息稀缺；多帧SR虽可利用亚像素互补信息，但现有方法通常依赖真实多帧训练序列并需重复特征编码，带来高昂的数据采集与计算成本。
method: 提出SPS-GS的encode-once框架，仅从单张高分辨率图像合成的多相位LR观测中学习，无需真实多帧训练序列。其中PCAD通过基于傅里叶的配准、相位感知残差融合与最小二乘混叠估计，在单次深度编码前完成多帧信息整合；GPA则利用多观测反投影迭代优化高斯中心与颜色以提升观测一致性，精化后的高斯支持任意尺度的连续渲染。
result: 在五个遥感数据集上的实验表明，该方法相对单图像与多帧SR基线均取得更强的重建性能，并在常见尺度下保持有竞争力的推理效率；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作以单次编码替代重复特征编码，规避了对真实多帧序列的依赖，在性能与效率间取得平衡，为任意尺度遥感超分提供了新的高斯泼溅式技术路线，代码将公开。

title: Wear and Go: Calibration Free Sparse Inertial Motion Capture via Online Sensor Setup Estimation
abstract: Sparse inertial motion capture typically assumes that each sensor's anatomical identity and mounting orientation are known. We present MOSAIC (Motion-based Sensor Assignment and Inertial Calibration), a framework that recovers this setup from ordinary motion without a calibration pose. Our central insight is that body pose changes continuously while the sensor setup persists, allowing movements that are individually ambiguous to provide complementary evidence over time. A setup network processes unordered sensor streams with temporal and cross-sensor attention, then accumulates assignment and rotation evidence into a session-level estimate. The recovered setup canonicalizes measurements for frozen pretrained pose estimators, separating sensor configuration from motion reconstruction. For sensors worn at prescribed body sites, evaluation on real inertial recordings with randomized setups shows near-calibrated pose accuracy for bounded offsets and substantial benefits from accumulation under arbitrary orientations. Transfer across pose networks supports setup recovery as a reusable interface between interchangeable sensors and pretrained pose models.
tldr: 提出MOSAIC，无需校准姿势即可从日常运动中在线估计稀疏惯性传感器配置并用于姿态重建。
motivation: 稀疏惯性动作捕捉通常假设每个传感器的解剖身份与佩戴朝向已知，实际使用前往往需要专门校准姿势。本文旨在从普通运动中自动恢复传感器配置，实现免校准的“穿上即用”动作捕捉。
method: MOSAIC利用身体姿态连续变化而传感器配置保持不变的特性，通过带时序注意力和跨传感器注意力的setup network处理无序传感器流，并将分配与旋转证据累积为会话级估计。恢复出的配置用于对冻结的预训练姿态估计器输入做规范化，从而将传感器配置与动作重建解耦。
result: 在真实惯性记录和随机传感器配置下，当传感器佩戴于规定身体部位且偏移有界时，方法达到接近校准后的姿态精度；在任意朝向下，证据累积带来显著收益。摘要未给出具体量化数值指标。
conclusion: 该方法无需校准姿势即可在线恢复传感器身份与朝向，可作为可复用接口连接可互换传感器与预训练姿态模型，推动免校准、即穿即用的稀疏惯性动作捕捉。

title: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
tldr: 设计并实现面向工业任务的@Work移动操作机器人，集成Mecanum底盘、机械臂、SLAM、A*与YOLO。
motivation: 该研究面向工业场景中重复性或危险性任务，目标是提升此类作业的效率与自动化水平。论文旨在设计并实现Auriga Robotics的移动操作机器人@Work Robot，以验证其在工业环境中的自主导航、物体操作与任务执行能力。
method: 硬件采用四轮Mecanum驱动实现全向移动，配备5自由度机械臂和3D打印夹爪；电子系统基于ESP32自定义PCB，并使用NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX负责高层处理与实时控制。软件采用Hector SLAM进行建图与定位、A*进行路径规划、YOLO进行实时目标检测，并融合传感器数据实现鲁棒导航与避障。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；仅报告系统在类工业场景中实现了有效的软硬件集成，并在自主导航、物体操作和任务执行方面表现出稳定一致的性能。
conclusion: 论文贡献在于完成@Work移动操作机器人从硬件结构、电子系统到SLAM、路径规划与目标检测软件模块的系统集成。结果表明该平台具备在工业环境中执行自主导航与物体操作任务的潜力，但摘要未给出量化实验数据与对比结论。

title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.
tldr: 提出任务自适应多级几何融合框架SpatialMind，提升多模态大模型3D空间推理能力。
motivation: 多模态大语言模型在2D视觉理解上表现突出，但3D空间推理仍受限。现有引入3D重建模型的方法要么对所有任务使用单一几何粒度，要么采用固定多级融合方案，难以满足不同认知层级空间任务对几何粒度的差异化需求。
method: 提出任务自适应框架SpatialMind，其核心GeoFus是多层几何融合模块，通过联合文本指令、视觉语义和几何表示的门控网络，动态调节浅层、中层和深层几何特征在LLM解码器各层中的贡献；同时引入负熵正则损失以缓解门控坍塌。
result: 在多个空间基准上取得有竞争力的性能，VSI-Bench达到72.3的最先进分数；门控可视化表明GeoFus能够根据任务需求自适应调整几何粒度。
conclusion: 该工作证明任务自适应多级几何融合优于固定融合方案，能更好应对多样空间推理需求，为MLLM的3D空间理解提供了可推广框架，公开代码有助于后续研究。

title: Cross3DGS: Unified Vulkan-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting Training from Workstations to Mobile Devices
abstract: Scenes captured with handheld and wearable cameras are still shipped to a CUDA workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training. Training on the device that captured them, or on its companion phone or laptop, requires more than translating kernels: GPUs and drivers differ in parallel features, memory limits, and command submission, and these differences decide whether a training schedule executes and returns the correct update. We present Cross3DGS, a cross-vendor, cross-platform Vulkan trainer that keeps one optimizer and chooses its execution schedule per device in two steps: rules on device limits, workload size, and observed driver failures exclude the schedules known not to run correctly, and a fixed preference order selects one of the remaining feasible schedules. The same core completes standard-quality training (30k updates, one million Gaussians) on every configuration we measured, spanning NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD, and Apple GPUs and including Android devices and an iPhone, whereas the existing portable trainers VkSplat and Brush do not run on some of the mobile GPUs. Averaged over 11 scenes on a workstation, Cross3DGS has higher quality than VkSplat with no significant difference in training time, and Brush reports about three times the training time at comparable quality. The final quality of Cross3DGS is nearly identical across devices. A mobile application turns a handheld capture into a viewable model entirely on the device.
tldr: 提出基于 Vulkan 的跨厂商跨平台 3DGS 训练器，可在工作站与手机端完成训练。
motivation: 手持和可穿戴设备捕获的场景通常仍需送至 CUDA 工作站进行 3DGS 训练；要在捕获设备或其配套手机、笔记本上训练，必须解决不同 GPU 与驱动在并行特性、内存限制和命令提交上的差异，这些差异会决定训练调度能否正确执行并产生正确更新。
method: Cross3DGS 是一个跨厂商、跨平台的 Vulkan 训练器，保持单一优化器，并按设备分两步选择执行调度：先根据设备限制、工作负载大小和观测到的驱动故障规则，排除已知无法正确运行的调度；再按固定偏好顺序从剩余可行调度中选择。
result: 在 NVIDIA、Intel、Arm、Qualcomm、AMD、Apple GPU（包括 Android 设备和 iPhone）的所有测量配置上，均完成 30k 次更新、100 万高斯的标准质量训练，而现有可移植训练器 VkSplat 和 Brush 在部分移动 GPU 上无法运行；在 11 个场景的工作站平均结果中，Cross3DGS 质量高于 VkSplat 且训练时间无显著差异，Brush 在相近质量下训练时间约为其三倍，跨设备最终质量几乎一致。
conclusion: Cross3DGS 实现了从工作站到移动设备的统一 Vulkan 3DGS 训练，提升了跨设备可移植性与移动端可用性；其移动应用可在设备上完全将手持捕获转换为可查看模型。

title: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
abstract: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io.
tldr: 提出面向全景相机的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM框架CoSphere-SLAM，利用球面回环与Sim(3)优化提升轨迹和建图。
motivation: 全景智能体可在任意3D朝向观测重叠场景，但全旋转搜索会跨对称房间产生一致假回环；同时单目尺度漂移和短基线深度噪声会破坏刚性合并地图与回环平移方向。
method: CoSphere-SLAM通过快速傅里叶相关在SO(3)上对齐球面特征，并用全局Sim(3)一致性拒绝对称假回环；随后以带对数尺度正则化的逐关键帧Sim(3)位姿图进行方向性全局优化，分离光流平移方向与深度幅值；最后按关键帧相似度变换高斯并以最大射线响应渲染，联合优化位姿与地图。
result: 在室内与跨会话多智能体全景基准上，CoSphere-SLAM在单智能体和多智能体方法中取得最优轨迹精度与渲染质量；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个面向全景相机的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM框架，贡献球面回环、Sim(3)一致性与全向高斯融合，可服务搜索救援、建筑巡检和仓储自动化等密集协同建图场景。

title: HandRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. On HOT3D, HandRSI's MPJPE-p is 16% lower than that of ACE-Ego-Hand fine-tuned on the same ground truth. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.
tldr: HandRSI通过递归自我改进推理框架与选择性蒸馏，显著降低第一人称手部姿态估计误差与抖动。
motivation: 第一人称3D手部姿态估计在图像边缘漏检、遮挡时定位错误且存在抖动；现有方法通常分别手工设计推理优化和微调，但两者相互依赖却分开调优。
method: HandRSI将视频估计器与可执行推理框架结合，每轮由编码智能体改进推理框架，仅在留出数据上十项指标综合提升且无显著回退时接受。接受后的推理框架通过选择性蒸馏指导估计器，在无真值帧上监督手部存在性与时序一致性，真值帧监督姿态，并在更新后的估计器上重新验证推理框架。
result: 从ACE-Ego-Hand出发，五轮后MPJPE-p在HOT3D降低35%、ARCTIC降低11%，抖动约减半；HOT3D上MPJPE-p比同真值微调的ACE-Ego-Hand低16%，统一协议下在两项基准全部十项指标上优于九个复跑已发表方法。基于精度-速度前沿的超体积选择得到Lite、Medium、Heavy系统，运行速度为20.7至41.1 FPS。
conclusion: 该工作提出推理框架优化与估计器选择性蒸馏交替进行的递归自我改进闭环，并公开完整方法、各轮阶段、协议、代码、评估器、推理框架与权重，有望提升第一人称手部姿态估计的鲁棒性、时序稳定性和实际部署效率。

title: CueSplat: Learning to Schedule Sparse Deformation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting on Edge Devices
abstract: Deformation-based 4D Gaussian splatting (4DGS) enables dynamic scene rendering. However, evaluating deformation networks for all Gaussians at every frame is compute-intensive on edge devices. We find that Gaussian trajectories are often locally predictable, yet prediction reliability varies across Gaussians and time. Thus, we propose CueSplat, a post-training framework that exploits local temporal regularity while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and retaining its Gaussian set. Specifically, CueSplat predicts Gaussian attributes from recent history and uses a lightweight learned router to select exact deformation updates within a scene-specific budget calibrated offline. Selection accounts for prediction reliability and rendering contribution. Selected indices are reused across nearby frames to reduce routing overhead, while selected Gaussians still receive exact updates each frame. To control accumulated prediction error, we use drift signals to schedule three consecutive full-deformation frames that rebuild the prediction history. Evaluated across four mainstream 4DGS algorithms, CueSplat achieves up to $6.74\times$ and $8.15\times$ speedups on Jetson AGX Orin and Orin NX, respectively, with a negligible quality drop (at most $0.16$ dB in dataset-average PSNR).
tldr: CueSplat 通过预测与稀疏精确变形调度，在边缘设备上加速 4D 高斯泼溅渲染。
motivation: 基于变形的 4D 高斯泼溅需要在每一帧对所有高斯评估变形网络，在边缘设备上计算开销很大。高斯轨迹通常具有局部可预测性，但预测可靠性会随高斯和时间变化，因此需要按需调度精确变形计算。
method: CueSplat 是一种后训练框架，保持预训练主干冻结并保留其高斯集合；它利用近期历史预测高斯属性，并用轻量学习路由器在离线校准的场景特定预算内选择精确变形更新，选择时考虑预测可靠性和渲染贡献。被选索引在邻近帧间复用以减少路由开销，同时漂移信号会调度连续三个全变形帧来重建预测历史以控制累积误差。
result: 在四种主流 4DGS 算法上评估，CueSplat 在 Jetson AGX Orin 和 Orin NX 上分别实现最高 6.74 倍和 8.15 倍加速，数据集平均 PSNR 最多仅下降 0.16 dB。
conclusion: CueSplat 在不修改预训练主干和高斯集合的前提下，利用局部时间规律与稀疏精确更新显著降低边缘设备上的动态渲染计算量。该方法在多个 4DGS 算法上取得大幅加速且画质损失可忽略，为边缘端动态高斯泼溅部署提供了有效方案。

title: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
abstract: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $π^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.
tldr: 提出层匹配稀疏注意力LMSA，在低冗余视角下加速VGGT并保持位姿精度。
motivation: VGGT单次从未标定图像重建相机与几何，但全局注意力随视角数二次增长；现有免训练稀疏加速器在冗余视频上有效，却在视角几何重叠低时损失位姿精度。作者将损失归因于扩散层与匹配层两类跨视角信息难以被统一稀疏近似同时保留。
method: 提出层匹配稀疏注意力LMSA：用每层被均值token遗漏的对数质量统计量衡量层类型，并以无行依赖的logit方差代理逐层选择估计器。扩散层采用共享的重要性采样hub键与无偏log权重，保持softmax分子分母无偏；匹配层保持精确注意力，避免激进稀疏。
result: 在13个未见低冗余场景、32视角下，LMSA与稠密注意力的AUC@5差距为1.4，而AVGGT和SAF3R分别为10.3和4.5；与GPA-VGGT差异不显著，仅对AVGGT的提升通过两项场景级检验。100视角下差距为1.9且聚合器快2.0倍；事后用于选择GPA-VGGT保护层可在增加5% FLOPs下提升1.2 AUC@5。在π^3上未经调优即超过AVGGT，但距稠密精度仍更远。
conclusion: LMSA在低冗余3D重建中实现接近稠密注意力的位姿精度与显著加速，并给出可复用的逐层稀疏选择统计量。其可提升GPA-VGGT的层保护策略并迁移至π^3，但跨模型迁移仍未达到稠密精度。

title: Trust the Ray, Not the Depth: Ray-Lateral Agreement for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Fusion
abstract: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. Its error therefore points almost entirely along its own viewing ray, and the calibration tells us that direction exactly. To address this, we introduce the Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA), which follows one rule: trust the ray, not the depth. RLA first slides every estimate along its own rays, which removes the depth bias and leaves the shape untouched. It then fuses the views one point at a time, under a Gaussian error whose precision follows each viewing ray. The maximum-likelihood solution is closed-form, interpolates between averaging and midpoint triangulation, and stays well conditioned where triangulation is singular. Robustness is the harder half, because correct views also disagree along their rays. Any weight built on the full residual therefore punishes good views together with bad ones. Ray-lateral agreement instead scores every view, at every point, by its residual across that view's own ray alone. We evaluated RLA on multi-camera public benchmark datasets. Across two, three, and four cameras and three per-view pose estimators, RLA consistently achieves lower worst-case error than all triangulation baselines.
tldr: 提出Ray-Lateral Agreement，按视线而非深度融合多视角3D人体姿态，降低最坏误差。
motivation: 将单目网格估计器用于标定相机阵列时，网络假设的焦距会引入深度偏差，使重建人体相距一米以上，且误差几乎沿各自视线方向。研究要解决的是如何利用已知标定方向消除该深度偏差，并在正确视角沿视线仍不一致时鲁棒融合多视角结果。
method: Ray-Lateral Agreement（RLA）先沿每个估计自身的视线滑动以去除深度偏差并保持形状不变，再逐点融合各视角，采用精度沿视线变化的高斯误差模型，得到闭式最大似然解；该解在平均与中点三角化之间插值，并在三角化奇异时保持良态。鲁棒评分不使用完整残差，而是用每个视角、每个点在其自身射线上的横向残差为各视角打分。
result: 在多相机公开基准数据集上，覆盖2、3、4个相机和三种单视角姿态估计器，RLA的最坏情况误差始终低于所有三角化基线；摘要未提供具体误差数值。
conclusion: RLA通过“信任射线、不信任深度”的融合准则，将深度偏差转化为沿视线的定位不确定性，并利用标定视线实现闭式、鲁棒的多视角3D人体姿态融合。该方法对相机阵列与单目网格估计器的组合具有实用价值，并可推广到类似的多视角几何融合问题。

title: mmTherm: Absolute 3D Human Pose Estimation from Low-Resolution Thermal Images and mmWave Radar
abstract: Absolute 3D human pose estimation (HPE) aims to recover both a person's body pose and their global position in 3D space. Privacy-preserving millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides distance and direction measurement capabilities, but its sparse point clouds make HPE under-constrained. Low-resolution thermal imaging can provide complementary observations of body direction and structure. However, our evaluation shows that a strong feature-level fusion baseline loses much of its localization and HPE advantage when generalizing to unseen subjects, with radial localization becoming less accurate than a radar-only baseline. Motivated by this finding, we introduce mmTherm, a lightweight framework that explicitly incorporates the complementary geometric properties of thermal imaging and mmWave radar. It combines body structure and joint directions estimated from thermal images with range information from radar to localize the body and reconstruct its 3D pose. Experiments on OctoNet show that mmTherm reduces cross-user absolute joint error by 33% and root localization error by 38% relative to the strongest corresponding baselines, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and less computation at inference.
tldr: mmTherm利用热成像与毫米波雷达几何互补，实现低分辨率热图下的绝对3D人体姿态估计。
motivation: 绝对3D人体姿态估计需同时恢复姿态与全局位置；毫米波雷达隐私保护好但点云稀疏导致HPE约束不足，低分辨率热成像可补充身体方向与结构信息。作者发现强特征级融合基线在跨受试者泛化时定位与HPE优势大幅下降，径向定位甚至不如仅雷达基线。
method: 提出轻量框架mmTherm，显式利用热成像与毫米波雷达的互补几何特性：从热图估计身体结构和关节方向，结合雷达距离信息进行人体定位与3D姿态重建。
result: 在OctoNet上，相较最强对应基线，mmTherm将跨用户绝对关节误差降低33%、根节点定位误差降低38%，同时参数量显著更少、推理计算量更低。
conclusion: 结果表明显式几何融合优于特征级融合在跨用户场景下的泛化，为隐私保护的绝对3D人体姿态估计提供了轻量高效方案。

title: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
abstract: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it.
