Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.
tldr: NIRJALA 通过三路径光学模型与可逆物理约束，从水下图像联合恢复无水的三维外观与几何。
motivation: 水下图像像素混合衰减场景辐射、后向散射与前向散射，存在严重病态性；现有高斯泼溅方法仅建模前两项并用指数透射率除水，导致反演增益无界。研究需要同时恢复无水外观与几何，并约束反演稳定性与误差传播。
method: 提出 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架 NIRJALA：TRIVENI 三路径成像模型在直接透射和后向散射外增加随距离饱和的前向散射项，证明反演增益在全距离有界并界定后向散射/衰减误差传播；PRATIBIMBA 将灵活神经水体模型与十参数物理模型双向绑定，防止场景内容藏入水体；SAMARASA 整合物理约束目标，含距离分箱颜色先验。
result: 在自建 SAJALA（30 个 Blender Cycles 路径追踪场景，含无水图像、深度、法线及受控水色/浊度）上，PSNR 从最强基线 24.34 提升至 24.76 dB，深度 AbsRel 从 0.109 降至 0.091；在真实 SeaThru-NeRF 场景上 LPIPS 从 0.194 降至 0.175，渲染达 44 FPS。
conclusion: NIRJALA 将水下恢复从简单透射率除法推进为可逆、有界的三路径物理建模，实现无水外观与几何联合恢复；同时讨论水下外观指标与几何指标不一致及评估局限，为后续评测提供基准。

title: Gaussian Splatoms: Direct Atomic Structure Identification in Electron Tomography
abstract: Atomic electron tomography (AET) computationally reconstructs the 3D atomic structure of materials from a series of 2D projection measurements acquired at different tilt angles. Inspired by Gaussian splatting techniques from computer vision, we introduce an atom-centric parameterization for modeling AET samples. Instead of a conventional volumetric representation with a grid of voxels, we model the sample as a list of atoms, where each atom is a 3D Gaussian characterized by learned location, scale, and amplitude. The Gaussian model is a natural fit for atoms that allows us to easily incorporate prior information grounded in physics; we impose isotropy of atoms, a minimum interatomic distance, and realistic atomic radii. We show in simulation that our method is more robust than volumetric baselines to real-world imaging challenges, including a limited number of measurements and low electron dose. We further show that our method yields a more physically plausible reconstruction of an experimental 23,000 atom iron-platinum nanoparticle than a previously published volumetric reconstruction. Beyond tomography, our representation is a promising tool for any atomic resolution imaging modality (e.g. multislice electron ptychography).
tldr: 提出以原子为中心的高斯参数化方法，用于电子断层扫描中直接识别三维原子结构。
motivation: 原子电子断层扫描需从少量倾斜投影重建三维原子结构，传统体素网格表示在测量受限、低电子剂量等实际成像条件下不够稳健，且重建物理合理性不足。
method: 受高斯泼溅启发，将样品表示为原子列表，每个原子为带可学习位置、尺度和幅度的三维高斯；引入各向同性、最小原子间距和真实原子半径等物理先验进行优化。
result: 仿真表明在测量数量有限和低电子剂量下比体素基线更稳健；对实验的23,000原子铁铂纳米颗粒重建比已发表体素重建更具物理合理性。
conclusion: 该方法实现直接原子结构识别，提升AET重建稳健性与物理一致性，并可推广到多层电子叠层成像等原子分辨率成像模态。

title: Bits, Not Boxes: Label-Free Layer Selection for Visual Localization in VLMs
abstract: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. We show that attention itself can identify them. A question changes how much a head attends to the image and where this attention goes. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. WhereBits turns these where-to-look bits into a layer prior and combines it with per-head contrastive scores. Its three design constants were fixed once on labeled COCO data, and a new model or resolution needs only unlabeled questions. Across eight VLMs, WhereBits matches the pointing accuracy of box-tuned layers on COCO and RefCOCO and ranks target tokens better. This advantage holds on a held-out model family and at higher resolutions. Its COCO pointing accuracy is 0.72, against 0.22 for mean attention. In training-free zoom-in, its crops raise V* accuracy by 6.0 points under forced-choice evaluation.
tldr: WhereBits利用无标注问题上的注意力比特选择VLM定位层，无需框标注，在COCO指向准确率达0.72。
motivation: VLM的注意力图可廉价反映模型看向何处，但注意力汇使其定位不可靠；对比通用提示虽可抑制汇，却只有部分层能定位被问对象。现有定位层选择方法依赖框标注或固定规则，本文旨在实现无标注的定位层选择。
method: WhereBits将问题对注意力头的影响分解为“关注图像多少”和“关注图像何处”两种效应，并在无标注问题上以比特度量后者形成层先验，再与逐头对比分数结合。三个设计常数仅在带标注COCO数据上固定一次，新模型或新分辨率只需无标注问题即可迁移。
result: 在八个VLM上，WhereBits在COCO和RefCOCO上匹配框调优层的指向准确率，并更好地排序目标token；优势在留出模型家族和更高分辨率下仍成立。其COCO指向准确率为0.72，而平均注意力为0.22；在免训练zoom-in中，其裁剪使V*强制选择评估准确率提升6.0个百分点。
conclusion: 本文表明注意力本身可识别VLM中适合视觉定位的层，提出无需框标注、可跨模型与分辨率迁移的WhereBits。该方法减少层选择对标注的依赖，并可提升免训练zoom-in等视觉定位应用表现。

title: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
abstract: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.
tldr: 提出以对象为中心的流式3DGS框架，通过对象感知锚点重分配与局部形变校正提升动态场景重建质量。
motivation: 现有时间与存储高效的流式3DGS方法依赖锚点选择与邻域插值，容易忽略对象特定运动，并在对象边界附近引入不一致。OCLDA-GS旨在同时处理大运动对象的锚点支持与精确对象边界建模。
method: OCLDA-GS动态重分配对象与运动感知的高斯锚点，为大运动对象分配锚点支持，并将高斯邻域限制在对象组内以细化边界；同时估计对象级刚体变换（如手部运动），并据此学习每锚点的局部形变校正（如衬衫褶皱）。
result: 在三个动态多视图视频数据集上，匹配细化预算下相比Instant Gaussian Stream，PSNR在N3DV提升0.169 dB、Meeting Room提升0.202 dB、Google Immersive提升0.199 dB；N3DV和Meeting Room细化时间步间平均PSNR下降分别减少9.2%和13.8%。
conclusion: 该方法在流式动态3DGS中同时提升重建质量与细化时间步间稳定性，为自由视点视频提供更精确的对象边界和局部形变建模能力。
